name: Dunkley's Gymnastics Camp
description_short: An overnight gymnastics camp in South Hero, Vermont, for gymnasts aged 7 to 17, from beginners to USAG Level 9, capped at 50 campers a session. Most weeks are for girls; weeks 5 and 6 are co-ed with boys' programming that adds ninja challenges and martial arts.
refund_policy_summary: A $300 non-refundable deposit is due with each session's application. Full payment is due by May 1, 2027, and there are no refunds after May 1, 2027.
notes: One week sessions cost $1,450 and two week sessions $2,600. Sessions run Sunday to Friday with a 3pm exhibition. 5% sibling discount.
